# Durable Documentation Templates

Use this small central set when creating current source-of-truth documentation.
Adapt headings to the subject and remove instructions or placeholders before
publishing.

- [Durable document](./durable-document.md) — current requirements,
  architecture, implementation, processes, references, and guides.
- [Decision record](./decision-record.md) — accepted technical or governance
  choices with alternatives and consequences.
- [Test plan](./test-plan.md) — durable test strategy, environments, gates, and
  residual risks.
- [Agent instruction](./agent-instruction.md) — rules and guides under
  `docs/guides/ai-agent/`.

Do not create dated plans, update diaries, completion reports, or investigation
logs from these templates. Use an active package under `docs/specs/` for
non-trivial delivery work, and use the installed Spec Lifecycle Manager's
templates rather than copying a spec-package template into this repository.
